desc:
Welcome to Night City's forgotten grid. Climb rooftops, crack crates, upgrade your cyberware and become the runner everyone fears.

CODES:
UPDATE1 - 1 Skill Tree Reset + 1 Faction Reset + 1 Stat Reset + 15 Spins
NEWLOOK - 1 New Outfit + 2 of every face reroll
TY500LIKES - $5,000 Cash + 75 Chips

PC CONTROLS:
WASD — Move | Space — Jump | Shift — Sprint
V — Crouch/Slide | Q — Dash | Alt — Shiftlock
Click — Attack | Right Click — Aim | F — Block
R — Heavy/Reload | B — Execute | G — Carry
E — Interact | Z/X/C — Cyberware
Ctrl + 1/2/3 — Inhalers | Tab — Scanner
P — Phone | I — Inventory | N — Emotes | M — Menu

CONSOLE CONTROLS (Xbox / PlayStation):
A/Cross — Jump | B/Circle — Dash
L3 — Sprint | R3 — Crouch/Slide
RT/R2 — Attack | LT/L2 — Heavy/Aim
LB/L1 — Block | X/Square — Interact/Reload
Y/Triangle — Switch Weapon
D-Pad Down — Phone; hold for Inventory
Hold RB/R1 + X/Y/B or Square/Triangle/Circle — Cyberware
More controls: Settings → Controls.

Leave your feedback and suggestions!
